title: plectronia korthalsii
intro: Plectronia korthalsii, commonly known as the Plectronia plant, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The Plectronia plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
